properties.name: Lamai Breakfast
properties.address: 138/1 Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Popular local Thai breakfast spot known for congee (jok) and traditional morning dishes.

properties.name: Punch It Gym
properties.address: Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Muay Thai training gym with daily sessions for all levels — beginner to fighter.

properties.name: Chatpichit Muay Thai Gym
properties.address: 63 Lamaipattana 3, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Traditional Muay Thai camp with experienced trainers. Individual and group sessions available.

properties.name: Tamarind Springs
properties.address: 265/1 Tambon Lemat, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Koh Samui's first forest spa (est. 1998). Nestled in the rainforest with natural granite boulders, steam caves, and herbal pools. One of the island's finest wellness experiences.

properties.name: Lotus Eat Market
properties.address: 131/3 Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Evening street food market with local vendors, fresh produce, and Thai street snacks.

properties.name: Meal Prep Beachside
properties.address: 156/3 Haad Lamai Road, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84320
properties.notes: Healthy meal prep and clean-eating restaurant on the beachside road. Macro-friendly menus, protein bowls, and smoothies.

properties.name: Balkan Corner Samui
properties.address: 139 Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Eastern European cuisine in Lamai — grilled meats, Balkan specialties, and a relaxed terrace vibe.

properties.name: Samui Bakery & Patisserie by SEB
properties.address: 179/4 Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: French-style bakery and patisserie. Fresh bread, croissants, pastries, and custom cakes baked daily by a French pastry chef.

properties.name: Papé
properties.address: 83/25 Haad Lamai Road, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Artisan bakery with fresh-baked bread, pastries, and light bites. A quiet neighbourhood find on the main Lamai road.

properties.name: The Bamboo
properties.address: 124/433 Tambon Malet, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: All-day dining with Thai and international options. Relaxed bamboo-and-garden setting, popular with expats and long-stay visitors.

properties.name: Nana Tam
properties.address: 83/25 Haad Lamai Road, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Local Thai restaurant with a broad menu. Known for fresh seafood and classic Thai dishes at fair prices.

properties.name: Chalay Rock Bar
properties.address: 208/6 Moo 4, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Cliffside bar on the eastern cape of Lamai with dramatic sea views. Sundowners, cocktails, and a rock-music vibe.

properties.name: Outdoor Gym
properties.address: Lamai Beach area, Ko Samui, Surat Thani
properties.notes: Free public outdoor gym on the beachfront. Resistance machines, pull-up bars, and parallel bars with a sea breeze.

properties.name: Stone Turtle Cape
properties.address: Southern cape, Ko Samui, Surat Thani
properties.notes: Natural rock formations on the southern headland of Lamai Beach resembling a giant stone turtle. Great sunset viewpoint with a small spirit house.

properties.name: Hin Ta & Hin Yai (Grandmother & Grandfather Rocks)
properties.address: 126/92 Moo 3, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Koh Samui's most iconic natural landmark — rock formations shaped by sea erosion into unmistakably genital shapes. Local legend links them to an elderly couple lost at sea. Small souvenir stalls and entry is free.

properties.name: Harry's Sportsbar & Grill
properties.address: 124/158-159 Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Lively sports bar showing live international sports. Cold beers, grilled food, and a busy atmosphere on match nights.

properties.name: Lotus's Lamai (Supermarket)
properties.address: 131/12 Thawirat Phakdi Road, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Full-size Lotus's hypermarket — the main supermarket for Lamai. Fresh produce, imported goods, pharmacy, ATM, and food court.

properties.name: Me Coffee
properties.address: Had Lamai 3, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Cosy neighbourhood coffee shop. Good espresso, iced lattes, and Thai-style coffee drinks at local prices.

properties.name: Wi Num Korat
properties.address: 150/10 Moo 4, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Northeastern Thai (Isaan) restaurant — grilled meats, som tam, larb, and sticky rice. Local favourite with authentic Korat-style cooking.

properties.name: Lamai Fresh Market (ตลาดสดละไม)
properties.address: Haad Lamai 4 Road, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Main morning fresh market for Lamai. Local vendors selling fresh fish, meat, vegetables, fruit, and prepared foods. Best visited early morning for the widest selection.

properties.name: Roaming Coffee
properties.address: Lamai Night Market area, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84130
properties.notes: Morning specialty coffee pop-up at the Lamai market area. Single-origin pour-overs, cold brew, and light breakfast bites.

properties.name: Phu's Massage
properties.address: Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Highly regarded local massage therapist known among expats and long-stay visitors for exceptional technique. Book ahead — sessions fill up quickly.

properties.name: Community Club Lamai
properties.address: Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Friendly neighbourhood massage and wellness club. Traditional Thai massage, foot reflexology, and oil treatments at local prices. Popular with residents.

properties.name: 1% Coffee House Samui
properties.address: Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Specialty café serving third-wave coffee — single-origin pourover, AeroPress, and nitro cold brew. Minimalist design, fast Wi-Fi, and excellent pastries.

properties.name: Crystal Beach
properties.address: North Lamai, Ko Samui, Surat Thani
properties.notes: Secluded cove north of Lamai with crystal-clear water and fewer visitors than the main beach. Accessible via a short rocky path.

properties.name: Wat Ratchathamaram (Red Temple)
properties.address: Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Active Buddhist temple with a striking red facade, also known as Wat Sila Ngu. Notable for its ornate decorations and peaceful grounds. Respectful dress required.

properties.name: Wat Lamai
properties.address: ถนนทวีราษฎร์ภักดี, บ้านละไม, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: Neighbourhood Buddhist temple in the heart of Lamai. Ornate bot hall, resident monks, and a small cultural museum. Quiet mornings are best for a visit.

properties.name: Chez Pelo Butchery
properties.address: 101 Had Lamai 4, Tambon Maret, Ko Samui, Surat Thani 84310
properties.notes: French-run butcher and deli. Aged beef, homemade charcuterie, imported cheeses, and prepared dishes to take away. The go-to spot for a proper Western dinner at home.
